A standalone exact arithmetic verifier passed 1,003 finite assertions; infinite claims are proved analytically.

value.rationale: It supplies all-parameter exact controller counts and every minimum actuator location on a natural two-hub weighted tree, identifying isolated weight-induced rank losses and which spine nodes cannot repair them. It quantitatively separates fixed-weight controllability from the stronger zero-forcing requirement; rational exceptional weights have a particularly simple decision rule. The precise design fact is useful even without an energy bound.
